body:
I live in the US, so shipping took about a week and a half, I was able to track it after a few days. can't comment on discrete labels b/c I didn't opt in, but vial arrived in a unmarked delivery bag and an unmarked cardboard box, identical to baileym's review. bought with bitcoin, came out to around $65 at the time of purchase. 

also has been third party tested and i've had no issues with injections.

Shipping took about two weeks, but vials arrived intact and neatly packaged. My sole complain is that they forgot my novelty labels that I requested. 
I bought 2 vials (with bitcoin) which came out to about $130 USD.

They were disguised as essential oil of lemon, like the other review says.

very clear oil and discrete packaging, ordered as "disguised supplements" for only a dollar extra (label says essential oil of lemon). took around 25 days to get to me and was able to track parcel once it shipped. paid thru bitcoin, and price after everything was around $70. very grateful to this site and aurelia labs for helping me get started  = )
